entries.heading: The Secretary may extend the term
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 11003.  The Secretary may extend the term 
of a marketing assistance loan authorized by section 1201 of the 
Agricultural Act of 2014 (7 U.S.C. 9033) for any loan commodity to 12 
months:  Provided, That the authority made 
available pursuant to this section shall expire on September 30, 2020:  
Provided further, That the amount provided by this section is designated 
by the Congress as being for an emergency requirement pursuant to 
section 251(b)(2)(A)(i) of the Balanced Budget and Emergency Deficit 
Control Act of 1985.
